elements_selected.content: Implement the page-not-found fuzzy suggestion prompt (REQ-073). When the <page> argument does not match any indexed page title exactly: use the SimHash + Hamming distance matching from SPEC-001 (already implemented in src/simhash.rs) to find the top 5 closest page titles; display them as a numbered selection prompt in a TUI overlay (or plain text if alternate screen not yet entered): '1. <title>  2. <title>  ...' with a 'Select [1-5] or q to quit:' prompt. If the user selects a number 1–5, open the TUI on that page. If the user presses 'q' or Esc, exit 0 with no output. REQ-073, CON-023.
